entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with a representative, please press one.
Thanks for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for an order I placed a few weeks ago.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for a Performance Jersey and a VeloFit Pulse heart rate monitor, delivered 18 days ago. Are those the two items you're looking to return?
That's right. The jersey doesn't fit quite right, and the Pulse monitor just isn't what I was looking for.

I understand. Okay, I can definitely process the return for the jersey. That's well within our 30-day apparel return window. However, it looks like the Pulse falls under our electronics policy, which has a 14-day return window. Since it's been 18 days, I'm afraid I can't accept it for a refund.
Wait, what? I bought them in the same order. Why would you have separate policies for items shipped together? That makes no sense.

I can see why that would be frustrating, and I apologize for the confusion. Our apparel, like the jersey, has a standard return window. But for electronic devices like the Pulse, the policy is more limited due to the nature of the product. These separate policies should be listed on the product pages.
I don't remember seeing that. So you're telling me I'm just stuck with this expensive gadget I don't want because I missed the deadline by four days? I wanted to return these two items together.

I can't override the policy for a cash refund on the Pulse, and I am truly sorry about that. But I do want to find a solution for you. Since the difference in policies wasn't clear to you at the time of purchase, I can make a one-time exception and issue you a VeloFit store credit for the full value of the Pulse monitor.
Store credit? For the full amount?

Yes, for the full purchase price. You can use it on any other gear at any time, it never expires. I can still process the standard refund for the jersey to your original payment method. How does that sound?
Oh. Well, that's actually much better. I was looking at some of your cycling shoes anyway. Yes, that works for me. Thank you for doing that.

Of course! I'm happy we could work it out. I've just sent an email to you. It contains a pre-paid return label for the jersey, and your store credit code for the Pulse is in there as well, ready to use immediately. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. I really appreciate your help. You've been great.
It was my pleasure. Thanks for being a VeloFit customer, and have a wonderful day.
